reviews.text:
Unfortunately lost a customer. I brought 2 small-medium dogs is. I reviewed how I wanted my Maltipoo to be groomed, and they groomed him how they wanted. Gave him a lion's tail when I specifically said and wrote down, do not touch the tail. I said and wrote down poodle paws, they only touched up the feet. Missed trimming the fifth nail on both front paws. Just very sloppy work.
My second dog is a puppy so I can understand nothing was done besides the bath. What I do not understand is why they would charge me over $100 if they couldn't do the touch ups and extras I asked for. I will find a more reasonable dog groomer.

I had such a great experience at Besties Dog Spa! I brought my puppy Betty in for a haircut and they did an AMAZING job. Since she’s still a puppy, they let me know ahead of time that they might not be able to accomplish every single thing I requested depending on how well she tolerated the groom, which I really appreciated.

But they seriously went above and beyond! They managed to hit every request I had and Betty came out looking absolutely adorable. 🥹💕 They even added the cutest little pom-poms and a new collar, which was such a sweet touch. You can tell they really care about the dogs and take pride in what they do.

I couldn’t be happier with her first big-girl haircut. We will definitely be coming back to Besties! 🐶🎀✨
Only place I’ll bring my baby!
The best place and the sweetest staff! I would recommend this place to everyone.

I have had Cocker Spaniels for 40 years and in that time I have never found a groomer better than Tabitha at Besties. In fact, we have had three bad experiences with other salons where my dogs were injured. I never have to worry about Tabitha and my dog Allie, LOVES her!!!! Tabitha is like the "Dog Whisperer" of groomers. 🥰

I've taken my bestie here twice and have been impressed twice! Love that she's not spending hours in a crate and comes out looking and feeling great. Friendly staff, Price is reasonable and they have cute freebies to go when you pick your pup up. I will be a loyal customer for years to come - thanks Besties!

It was my dog’s first grooming. They explained they want a dog’s first grooming to be fun and enjoyable for the dog, rather than scary and stressful. They told me not to expect the coat to be too short, because they want to groom at the dog’s pace.

When I picked up my dog, he looked like a new dog; just look at the photos. They did an amazing job. I’ll be going back for sure.
The person on the phone was really helpful with setting an appointment. Really knowledgeable. Im definitely sticking to Besties.

The crew at Besties is the Best!

I've been bringing my Goldendoodle to Besties for a while now, and the team has been great. She used to be nervous about her nails, but their patience and gentle approach have really helped her overcome these fears. I recently brought along our new young puppy and they volunteered to help me desensitize her as well.

Beyond the skill and care, they're flexible, affordable, and the daycare playtime is a great bonus. Highly recommend to any Mission Hills dog parent!

The staff seemed nice but they didn't blow the hair off my dog and it got all over me and the car. When I reached out to them they didn't offer any way to make it right. I feel like I shouldn't have that kind of experience with how expensive stuff can be these days..

This review is long overdue! My pup, a Bernedoodle, has been going to Besties for the last 6 months. They’re the first and only groomer he’s ever been to. My breeder and vet both recommended we start getting him groomed as young as possible, so he would get used to it from a young age. After looking around for recommendations, we picked Besties and haven’t looked back!

Tabitha is awesome, she’s worked with us on desensitizing him to grooming, nail clips, baths and hair dryers. They took it really slow with him in the beginning, starting with just a bath and only clipping what he was comfortable with. I was a little stressed the first time we dropped him off, both to leave him and for how he would look after his first hair cut. He ended up looking so cute after and even had a little bow tie.

Now we come every month and he’s completely used to grooming. He always looks and smells great. He doesn’t even mind getting his nails done if Tabitha does it! He screams if I even try to trim them lol. Highly recommend besties and Tabitha, especially for younger puppies getting used to grooming.

I had such a wonderful experience at Bestest Dog Spa! The location is super easy to access, and having a good parking lot right next to it.  From the moment we walked in, the man at the reception was incredibly kind and welcoming. He explained everything clearly and made me feel completely comfortable leaving my dog there.
A special thank you to Lily, who did the grooming so beautifully. She was attentive, professional, and clearly cared about doing a great job. My dog came back looking absolutely adorable, clean, and perfectly groomed. I’m genuinely so happy with the results.
You can tell this place really cares about both the pets and their owners. My dog will definitely be coming back.
They were able to get our pup in last minute after a very sandy beach trip :) they treated him with kindness and love, and did such a good job! I highly recommend Besties :)

I would not come back. If you’re looking for a good haircut, don’t come here. They do a terrible job and try to charge you extra for everything — even for simply doing their job.

Also, if your dog has just a couple of knots, they’ll tell you the dog needs to be shaved because they “can’t do their job.” Honestly, don’t come here. The staff is very rude, and it’s very expensive for what they do.

There are many much better places with specialized people who actually know about breeds and proper cuts.

Eh probably wouldn't come back here again. Came to pick up my dog and the old guy mentioned that my pup poked one of the groomers and charged me $20 more since my dog was probably anxious because it was his first time getting groomed at this place. The old guy's comment was they probably wouldn't take my dog again next time, even though I mentioned in the notes when I made an appointment that my dog is a biter. Then continued to tell me to let them know ahead when I clearly did lol. Not my fault that they didn't read what I said when I made the appointment.  But other than that my dog's haircut was fine. Never had a problem with other groomers. They never complained and charged me $20 because my dog is a biter for being anxious. And I feel like they should know that? especially if they know we are a first time customer. But yeah we're not going back. That was such a turn off. He didn't have to say "we probably won't take you next time" then tell me they're charging me $20. Lol thanks tho. There are other much better ones who are understanding and know how to handle dogs more when they're anxious and nervous. Definitely going back to our regular grooming place, since they're way better, nicer to customers and understanding with my pup @pupperclub.

Absolutely lovely experience from start to finish! The front staff was really kind and the Groomer was very professional and loving towards my pet. This was my first time coming in, and I showed up as a walk-in fully expecting them to not have availability, but they went above and beyond to accommodate me. When I picked up my pup, she was quite excited and looked well taken care of. I had to do a short cut this time as I went a little crazy with the home trim around her snout, but they made her look adorable. Would highly recommend :)

I’ve been taking my dog Frankie to Besties Dog Spa for about a year now, and I can’t recommend them enough. The scheduling process is always easy, the staff is professional and friendly, and the pricing is very reasonable for the quality of care they provide. I always make sure to request Lily—she is truly the best! Frankie always comes back looking great and happy, which gives me so much peace of mind.

Very nice, professional, and knowledgeable staff. I don't feel oversold or pushed to get any service or even schedule an appointment which I appreciate. They have done a good job with my golden retriver multiple times now and my dog seems to enjoy going and looks great after.
Besties is the best! Truly some of the nicest people around. They’re great at making my dog feel comfortable, and the grooming is always really well done. Couldn’t recommend them more!!

Bestie’s Dog Grooming in Mission Hills is truly dog-first and incredibly helpful! They not only give my pup a phenomenal clean-up every single time, but also make the whole experience so easy and positive for me—from scheduling to drop-off and pick-up. Recently, they’ve gone above and beyond helping me navigate my dog’s new allergies with so much kindness and knowledge. It’s clear they genuinely care about every dog that comes through their doors. I can’t recommend them enough!
Very good service and friendly

So grateful to take Kiki to her first grooming experience at Besties! She looks so well taken care of. When I dropped her off, she was a bit nervous as she usually is but when I went to go pick her up, she was so happy and joyful!

Thank you so much Nick and his team for taking care of my Kiki!

Besties for my bestie🐕✨🩷 Jax and I had another groomer in the area that closed its doors, which led our search to Besties. I drove by a few times and said "wow, cute name!". Once it was time for Jax's next bath, I already had this place in mind.

I called to make an appointment over the phone. They kindly let me know they book a week out and sent a couple text reminders. Very helpful! Day of our appointment we arrive and the lobby is very clean, there's a few dogs snoozing and already getting their glow up and it's only 9:30. Efficient! Checking in we talked about what our plans were with Jax's session that day and his temperament since it was his first visit. Jax is a 12 y/o shar pei/chow mix and typically not super friendly or compliant with dogs or people. I always get a little nervous when we have to introduce him to someone new, but this team is super profesh and knows exactly what they're doing!

When it was time to pick up Jax they sent out another text reminder. Jax was super clean, de-shedded, and he even let the team trim his nails and clean his teeth. Not easy for a stubborn old man dog!

Jax and I will definitely be back. Thanks Besties team!
Employees were very kind, very fair prices and my doggo looks great !

This place is great! My dog is difficult, and when I say difficult, I mean he is old, arthritis and he also hates most people. But, this place makes it work! The receptionist is super helpful and provides reasonable and good advice, the 24 hr reminder is helpful, and the groomers are kind and clearly good at their job. I'm so lucky I live nearby. Highly recommend.

If you are looking for a new groomer, I want to recommend “Besties Dog Spa”. We have a 15 year old blind Shih Tzu  ( Maui ) and we feel very comfortable taking him there. We had a previous groomer for our dog for years, but she moved out of state. We did our homework to find the best place possible for our Maui and we found it. The people who work at Besties take great care of him and they really do love what they do. The owner went out of his way to check in on Maui when he got sick, they really care.  Give “Besties Dog Spa” a try, we know how hard it is to find a good dog groomer. 🐶
Marie, David, and Maui 💚
My dogs love everyone who works here! Their always well taken care of - we love, Besties!

I’ve been taking my dog to Besties since I moved to San Diego and I can’t say enough! Every visit has been great and my pup loves them.  He even tried to head back to the grooming area today without so much as saying goodbye to me. He’s a senior and needs extra gentle care and Besties is amazing with him. Thank you!

Besties is the Best!  I use them for grooming my little Shih Tzu every month for over a year now, and they always do a great job.  And I love that they’re cage-free!  I’ve recently used their hourly day-boarding service, which was equally great!  I can’t recommend them enough!!
🐶💖 …
Absolutely the best!!! My first time bringing my lil Lola here and she was beautiful!
Best dog groomer in SD! kind people, do a good job, and not $150 for a small dog 👍🏼 …

Ziggie loves her friends at Besties! They do a beautiful job grooming this standard poodle! She is always excited to see her pals who treat her like a queen! They are thorough, conscientious, and earnest! Great care of Ziggie, great, happy vibe!

I can’t recommend Besties enough. I have an anxious rescue pup and while she’ll never be excited to go to any groomer, she’s done the best here out of anywhere we’ve tried out. Everyone at Besties is so nice and accommodating, they keep track of the services you’ve had done before and know what products do/don’t work for your pet. My dog has always had some skin sensitivity and hates getting her nails cut, so it’s important to me that they know what shampoo to use on her and know to always grind her nails instead of using clippers. We have always had a great experience and will continue coming here.

Our puppy was rescued from the streets of Tijuana and was very nervous around new people. The folks at Besties allowed us to come in every weekend for treats and love. After months of acclimating, she finally allowed them to give her a nail grinding. It is now one of her favorite places to go. We appreciate the love and patience Besties has shown to our pup.

I can’t recommend Besties enough! While traveling, I entrusted them with the care of my dog, and they exceeded all expectations. Located conveniently in Bankers Hill/Hillcrest area, their dog boarding services are top-notch. From the moment I walked in, the team made me feel confident that my furry friend was in great hands.

Throughout my trip, they provided regular updates, including pictures and messages, which truly put my mind at ease. My dog was happy, healthy, and clearly well-cared for when I picked him up.

Although I didn’t use their grooming services this time, their facility is clean, welcoming, and fully equipped to handle all your pet’s needs. It’s clear they genuinely care about the pets they watch over. I’m looking forward to trying their grooming services next time!

If you’re in San Diego and need a reliable and caring place to board your dog or take advantage of professional grooming services, Besties is the best choice. My dog and I are so thankful for their care. Highly recommended!

It's been about 6 mins that I took my dog there   The groomer said she'd have to go short on his cut cause he had some matted hair, due to the fact I hadn't had a chance to take him.  When I picked him up , she told me , why didn't you say he was a biter? I told her, they've never told me that before.  Anyway they left him with a few bad Knicks on his body, along with an infestation of fleas.  Before his visit, yes his hair had grown a bit, but he never scratched or indicated he had fleas. After I took him home he wouldn't stop scratching, I checked him and bathed him and he was infested. I had to buy him flea medication for the fleas and his Knicks which were getting infected because of the scratching.  Up to this day, they left him with allergies and I still have problems with the fleas that have become immune to the medication. I have to continuously be checking him , curing him and it's caused us a lot of problems.  I've taken him to other places since then, and they always say his a good boy.  I will never go back to them.  Be careful with your babies, because they can't talk.  They can't really tell you what happened.

My dog and I had an unfortunate experience at this facility. While I truly want to believe it was an isolated incident, we ended up needing to visit the emergency room afterward because my dog wasn’t acting like himself.

I do have some concerns about the health and safety protocols in this place, as I received conflicting information when I asked for details about what happened during his visit. This left me uncertain about their procedures and communication.

As a new business, I understand they’re still learning and growing, and I believe they have good intentions to provide a safe and enjoyable experience for dogs. However, my visit with my medium size Pomsky didn’t go as I hoped, and I feel the circumstances might not have been ideal for him that day (busy season).

Additionally, one of the groomers seemed frustrated and not professional in my opinion.

I encourage pet owners to carefully explore their options before bringing their dogs here. While I truly hope they succeed and refine their practices, I’d recommend ensuring they’re the right fit for your pet’s needs before booking.

That said, I’m giving 2 stars because they did follow up with me to check on my dog, Kai, and stayed in touch for days to ensure he was feeling better. I really appreciated their care and communication after—it showed they were invested in making sure he is okay.

This is simply my personal experience, and I sincerely hope that every dog visiting this facility has a happy and positive experience.

Besties is truly the BEST! It’s clean, has quality treats right when you walk in, and the staff goes above and beyond for my pups. The customer service is genuine and sweet. Also the groomers don’t rush and I can tell that they put in quality time and effort with my dogs. It’s been a valuable experience for me so that my dogs don’t feel scared to come get groomed. Thank you for taking care of my babies and always making me feel welcomed!
This place is awesome. I took my cat in for a nail trim. They were fast and my cat was happy the whole time. Affordable too.

We had a great experience with Besties grooming our anxious and difficult to groom shih tzu. He is distrustful of strangers and very fidgety to groom, but Steph the groomer did a great job with his cut. The entire team at Besties was friendly and accommodating in working with our tough-to-groom little senior. Highly recommended!
Great team! Even though they have dog in their name, they do a great job with cats! We took our old lady in for a summer haircut and they did a wonderful job! It isn’t easy! …

My dogs loves jt.  Staff was nice and they were easy to drop
Off and pick up

Took all 3 of our golden’s to Besties and they look great fully groomed trimmed teeth cleaning ear cleaning super happy with the end results will be going back. If they ask how you heard about Besties tell them Antonio sent you 🤓 …
Loved the vibe here, I felt very comfortable leaving my pup here knowing they would treat her well, the groom itself was good as well, but the atmosphere was what I have been looking for!

Omg they did such a great job with my Lily .. I totally understand that she is very hyper and that it  has  been a while since she had been groomed. They did the best they could. It was exactly what I asked for and half the time that the …

Took my dog here! It was her first time going to the groomers. It didn’t take them too long and they asked all of the right questions when I dropped her off (does she have any sensitives, special requests, ect.). I felt they were very reasonably priced and my dog smells and looks amazing! We will be back!
